knownGaps: These controls compare persistent named towns to generalized Natural Earth city points. They do not independently prove the exact coordinate of a surviving 1898 street junction or surveyed feature.
The 2.5 km correspondence allowance is a conservative declared uncertainty, not a measured NE accuracy or a derived error bound. Do not treat it as a residual.
Built-up-symbol centres involve interpretation; uncertainty is recorded per point in native pixels. The printed town symbol is not a municipal territory polygon.
Do not describe a fitted low RMS as metre-level external accuracy. The source geodetic datum and map compilation accuracy remain unidentified.
No Borneo coverage. No source grid coordinates were used as the reference longitude/latitude for these controls.

coast-g7-town-water.note: G7 1893 printed east-harbour shoreline including river banks; colour-seeded candidates snapped to printed shore ink. School grounds excluded by source-image review. coast-g4-town-water.note: G4 1839 surveyed town high-water waterfront; stippled sand/mud flat is treated as intertidal water, not dry land. Singapore River mouth joins source bank endpoints through water; river upstream not reconstructed. Source1839 is16yearsafterL1start; G6isnotwhole-town1879evidence. Town-only source extent; Kallang mouth and west-of-sheet coast remain gaps. Second pass: independently digitised native-source lower-river bank water is in G4-river-water.geojson. The colour-following river trial was rejected because overprinted letters/streets could attract paths; its ink percentage is not bank accuracy. Upper river outside the source-qualified lower reach uses URA WATERBODY exclusions.

coast-g1-town-water.note: G1 1822 planned waterfront is a provisional backcast for L0, not an observed1819shoreline. Exact pre-reclamation1819coast remains unverified. SingaporeRiver mouth bank endpoints are joined through water; town-only extent outside which later-map evidence is a gap. Second pass: independently digitised native-source lower-river bank water is in G1-river-water.geojson. The colour-following river trial was rejected because overprinted letters/streets could attract paths; its ink percentage is not bank accuracy. Upper river outside the source-qualified lower reach uses URA WATERBODY exclusions.

coast-g9-main.note: Printed G9 main-island coastline; via positions from original colour boundary sampled32nativepx (~170m), not a freehand polygon. Historical CP continuity not fully reviewed; fit budget currently failed. Source trace is split into4consecutive parts because unchanged lib lines.ts DP collapses a closed single part with coincident endpoints.

coast-g11-main.note: Printed G11 main-island coastal arc from west to east side of Causeway; Johor/map frame excluded. Ends close through Johor outside URA Singapore land, used only as selector. Modern feature CP continuity unreviewed; residual budgetfailed.

coast-g16-main.note: G16 printed-ink retrace seeded from G11 coastal trace through independent G16 auto fit. Second pass uses six named controls (three original lighthouse stars with official MPA coordinates; three rocky cape tips); all nine anonymous Warper points and ambiguous hill/mangrove points excluded. Six controls do not meet the16-point whole-map gate. 1954/1961 age gap, north/west extrapolation and 78% shoreline-ink identification remain failed acceptance.

coast-g15-west-water.note: G15 Admiralty2587: natural western mainland shore from 1960–61 survey south of Tg Karang; later jetties/dredging/shipyard works do not define this shore. Approximate chart-coordinate registration using printed graticule; old datum and exact correction dates remain limits. Source extent ends before eastern Jurong/Pandan; no assertion of complete1961Jurong.
